full_details: Alse was out before four, and her shoes were wet. One bough over the door, and no more, and she will not bring a second. At the arch, white hawthorn and ribbons. Long Meg on the Rose's bill, and no sum. A garland went over the mud. Kemp improved a child's step and was asked again at once. On the tables, God's is the quarrel. You will play the old man when you come to him. At two you were Navarre. The book stayed with the house. You wrote nothing at evening prayer. The hush still came.
one_sentence: Mistress Ansell allowed one hawthorn bough and no ribbon, the gate was dressed, Kemp mended a dance twice, and the comedy still hushed a May Day house.
title: One bough, and the hush
